//: Lives at the repository root, not in frontend/, because the dashboard is an npm workspace: it imports @call-intel/shared, so the install and the build have to happen from the root where the workspaces are defined. Set the Vercel project's Root Directory to './' for this file to apply.
buildCommand: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @call-intel/frontend

rewrites.//: Client-side routing: without this, refreshing /calls/CALL_0052 returns Vercel's 404 instead of the app. Asset requests are excluded so a missing file still 404s honestly.

headers.//: Vite fingerprints asset filenames, so they are safe to cache forever.
index.html must never be cached, or a deploy keeps serving the old bundle.
